text:
tariq: Observability flagged KMS-wrapped ciphertexts in plaintext logs from an ingest pod. small count but definitely should not be logged. attaching snippet.

tariq: ```
2025-07-13T14:22:10Z INFO ingest: wrote blob bld_42 wrap_ciphertext=Crf...
2025-07-13T14:22:11Z INFO ingest: wrote blob bld_43 wrap_ciphertext=Crf...
```

leah: That suggests container mounted /var/keystore or a local file with wrapped values ended up in stdout. Any recent changes to the helm chart?

natalie: Yes, partner onboarding added a hostPath for a compatibility shim. It was supposed to be a readonly secret mount but the chart erroneously used hostPath. Partner SA: partner-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com had encrypter role on ingest-wrap-key.

security-bot: IAM: partner-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com performed crypto.encrypt on projects/redwood-prod/.../ingest-wrap-key at 2025-07-13T14:22:12Z.

infra-ops: Immediate proposed steps:
- remove hostPath usage from partner helm values and rollback the chart to deny mounts (leah)
- revoke partner SA encrypter role (natalie)
- create a new wrap key (ingest-wrap-rot1) and run a controlled rewrap of affected blobs (tariq)
- add OPA policy to block hostPath and specific path mounts in ingest namespace (infra-ops)
- extend Vault audit retention for ingest namespace to 120d and add alerting for unusual encrypt frequency (security-bot)

leah: I'll open the rollback PR for the helm chart and revert the partner value change. short deploy freeze requested.

natalie: Revoking encrypter role now. Keeping decrypt for a limited window while we verify no consumers break. Pushing terraform change to remove binding.

leah: rollout PR: https://git.redwood.internal/charts/ingest/pull/1287 - revert hostPath and set mountPropagation: None.

tariq: Rewrap approach: generate hitlist of blob ids that were created during the window (use storage logs), export to gs://redwood-sec/reports/ingest-hitlist-20250713.json (restricted), then execute rewrap in small batches (100). dual-key read support for 48h. Example run:

tariq: ```bash
python tools/rewrap.py --hitlist gs://redwood-sec/reports/ingest-hitlist-20250713.json --src-key projects/redwood-prod/.../ingest-wrap-key --dst-key projects/redwood-prod/.../ingest-wrap-rot1 --batch 100 --verify --dry-run
```

infra-ops: Adding OPA constraint PR: https://git.redwood.internal/policies/opa/pull/55 that denies hostPath mounts in namespaces matching ingest-*. will gate on merge.

security-bot: Ticket created: SEC-2190 "hostPath keystore exposure -> rewrap + helm rollback + OPA block". Owners: tariq, leah, natalie. Priority: P1.

sre-oncall: I'll coordinate a 20m deploy freeze. ETA 30m. I'll monitor decryption errors and CPU impact during rewrap. If failure rate >0.5% we roll back and investigate.

leah: After rollback merged, I'll run integration smoke tests for partner ingest and confirm no mount present.

natalie: Post-incident actions: rotate any service tokens used to access the affected GCS buckets, rotate CI secrets if they referenced the ciphertexts, schedule a postmortem and update onboarding docs to forbid hostPath and require use of Vault agent or KMS provider.

tariq: Will run staging dry-run now. Will post results and planned prod batch windows here.

security-bot: Reminder: please attach logs and hitlist to SEC-2190 ticket and mark status.

leah: Noted. Filing short summary in the ticket after dry-run.
